data.name: Pontoon 25 - Mission Bay Rental
data.headline: 2-4 hour options
data.description:
Our Pontoon 25′ is great for picnics and family outings on Mission Bay.

Holding up to 12 passengers – with padded seats and bimini top – pontoon boats are perfect for leisurely tours of the bay for your mid-sized group. Our luxurious 25′ pontoon boat is also equipped with a stereo system. Additional charge for fuel applies.
data.what_is_included:
Max of 12 passengers including children (not to exceed 1700 lbs.)
Must be 18+ to rent and drive
90hp Mercury outboard engine
Spacious, upholstered bench seating arrangement
Bimini top & swim ladder
Bluetooth stereo system
Pets Allowed
Life vests included (all sizes)

data.cancellation_notes: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund. Once you are within 72 hours, no changes or cancellations are permitted. Failure to show for reservation still incurs full rental rate and is not eligible for a refund or reschedule. As the renter, you are responsible for checking the weather forecast and making any desired changes at least 72 hours in advance.
